title: Beastmaster's Chain

sources.title: Animal Friendship
markers: | summary = It charms a [[beast]], convincing it that the caster means no harm.

summary: Cast Animal Friendship as an Action once per Long Rest. Target a Beast in range. Wisdom save negates the effect.

fields.Animal Friendship: 60 ft. Target a Beast with Intelligence 3 or lower. On a failed Wisdom save, it is Charmed for 10 turns, ending early if you or an ally harms it.
fields.Base value: 65 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
